channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: A quadrennial Tokyo festival returns to a changed Japan
item.description: Once every four years, Nezu Shrine celebrates a special version of its annual festival.

item.title: Phone booth set up in Hokkaido offers a place to speak to lost loved ones
item.description: The 2022 sinking of a tourist boat off Hokkaido left 20 passengers and crew members dead and six others unaccounted for.

item.title: Japan weighs $500 billion defense spending plan, sources say
item.description: If adopted, defense buildup spending for the five years from April 2027 would be nearly twice that in the current five-year plan.

item.title: Japan ready to respond to disorderly movements in FX market, Katayama says
item.description: Tokyo will act in accordance with a standing pact with Washington, the finance minister said a day before the U.S. holds its midterm elections.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
